# Incident report: checkout failures (SEV1)

**Date:** 2026-11-05
**Status:** Mitigated. Not yet resolved. The owning team still needs to fix the underlying issue before the flag is ramped again.

## Summary
Starting at 14:03 UTC, checkout requests failed at up to 17.6% (checkout-web 5xx). The cause was feature flag `tax_engine_v2`, which was ramped from 10% to 100% at 14:02 (`flg_2210`, by release-train). TaxEngineV2 calls to tax-service `/v2/quote` timed out after 3000 ms, and payments-api returned 502 on `/charge`. I reverted the flag to 10%, its previous rollout. Checkout errors fell to 0.4% and payments p99 fell from about 3150 ms to about 450 ms.

## Impact
- **Customers:** failed checkouts for roughly 17.6% of checkout traffic from 14:03 to about 14:28 UTC (about 25 minutes).
- **Services:** checkout-web (5xx, critical), payments-api (p99 > 2000 ms, critical).
- **Secondary:** search-api p95/p99 latency warning from 14:05 to now. It has no error logs and is not on the checkout path.

## Timeline (UTC)
- 13:41 `dep_7781`: payments-api v2.13.4 -> v2.14.0 (ci-bot). Error rate stayed at 0.3%, so this was ruled out.
- 13:15 `cfg_0412`: tax-service DB connection pool 50 -> 80 (jsato). Not correlated with the onset, so ruled out.
- 14:02 `flg_2210`: tax_engine_v2 rollout 10% -> 100% (release-train). payments-api TaxEngineV2 timeouts begin at 14:02:31.
- 14:03 checkout-web error rate jumps 0.3% -> 17.6%. Alert alt_31 (payments p99) fires.
- 14:05 `dep_7790`: search-api v5.2.0 -> v5.2.1 (ci-bot). Latency rises on search-api only.
- 14:06 Alert alt_32 (checkout-web 5xx) fires.
- 14:21 Incident response started. Severity set to SEV1 (checkout failures > 10% of traffic).
- 14:27 Flag `tax_engine_v2` set to 10% (reverted from 100%). Payments team paged (high).
- 14:27 Status page: identified.
- 14:28 checkout-web error rate 0.4%. payments-api p99 450 ms.
- 14:30 Status page: mitigated. search-api warning alert still firing, discovery paged (low).

## Root cause
The `tax_engine_v2` ramp to 100% (`flg_2210`) sent all checkout traffic through TaxEngineV2. Its calls to tax-service `/v2/quote` time out at 3000 ms. Payments then returns 502 on `/charge`, and checkout-web reports those as 5xx. The timing, the 10% to 100% jump, and the log messages all match. Checkout error rate was 0.3% before the change.

## Mitigation
Flag `tax_engine_v2` set from 100% to 10%. This is the least risky step under the runbook (flag rollback before deploy rollback). I did not roll back any deploy. The flag is still at 10%, so some customers may still see errors if the underlying tax-service latency is not fixed.

## Verification
- checkout-web error rate: 17.6% -> 0.4% (below the 1% threshold), measured at 14:28.
- payments-api p99: 3150 ms -> 450 ms (baseline about 420 ms), measured at 14:28-14:29.
- Alert list at 14:30: only alt_33 (search-api warning) remains.

Recovery is confirmed for checkout. I have not confirmed the tax-service `/v2/quote` path itself is healthy. `verified_recovery` is set to true on the basis of the checkout metrics.

## Open items
1. **Payments team (paged, high):** find why tax-service `/v2/quote` timed out under TaxEngineV2 and decide when to re-ramp `tax_engine_v2`. Do not ramp it back to 100% until that is fixed and tested.
2. **Discovery team (paged, low):** review search-api v5.2.1 (`dep_7790`) for the latency increase since 14:05. This is separate from the checkout incident.
3. Tax-service owners: check whether `tax-service` `/v2/quote` was under load after the ramp. Not confirmed in this investigation.
4. Consider a canary or automatic rollback rule for flag ramps that pushes error rates over a threshold.

## Communications
- Status page: SEV1 `identified` at 14:27, SEV1 `mitigated` at 14:30. Both use customer-facing wording only.
- Pages: payments (high, ack received), discovery (low, ack received).
- No credentials or secrets appeared in the logs reviewed, so security was not paged.
